:::{#person-profile}
:::

Dorina Thanou is a senior researcher and lecturer at EPFL, leading strategic research initiatives on AI for Health and Science under the EPFL AI Center. 
Her research interests include graph-based signal processing for data representation and analysis, as well as machine learning, with a particular focus on the design of interpretable and robust models for biomedicine. 
She is currently leading many interdisciplinary collaborations that aim at fostering the adoption of AI in medicine and health.
